title: Canonical DOOH Placement Attributes
description: DOOH installed-surface and scheduled-loop facts. These fields do not define creative acceptance, which is governed exclusively by effective canonical format_options. Visual placements may declare screen_resolution and motion; audio-only placements omit those screen-specific fields. For publisher_ref placements, product slot and loop values override publisher defaults while repeated screen_resolution and motion values must equal the publisher facts.

slot_duration_seconds.description: Scheduled duration of one ad slot in seconds; not the creative-duration contract.

loop_duration_seconds.description: Duration of the full ad loop rotation in seconds and the canonical source for loop duration.

motion.description: Physical motion capability of a visual DOOH screen, not an accepted-format declaration. Omit for audio-only placements.

impression_basis.description: Experimental (media_buy.dooh_impression_basis). Methodology tier the seller plans to estimate this placement's audience on, so a buyer can compare and filter products before buying. A product mixing screens on different tiers declares it per placement. Delivery reports the realised tiers, which can include the seller's model on a sensor-equipped screen while its sensor is not reporting. Sellers that emit it MUST list `media_buy.dooh_impression_basis` in `experimental_features`.

audience_multiplier.description: Experimental (media_buy.dooh_impression_basis). Planning audience per play for this placement: the `impressions / plays` the seller's forecasts use. Optional on `currency_measured` placements.
